def factor_tail_fragility_overnight_buffer(df):
    """Penalizes drawdown tail fragility, with a bounded buffer for overnight-led repricing."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    previous_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    downside_tail = (previous_close - df_copy["low"]).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    upside_tail = (df_copy["high"] - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downside_energy = downside_tail.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    upside_energy = upside_tail.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    tail_asymmetry = downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    drawdown = 1.0 - df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    phase_activity = (overnight_ret.abs() + intraday_ret.abs()).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    overnight_phase = ((overnight_ret - intraday_ret).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / phase_activity).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
    df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_overnight_buffer"] = -tail_asymmetry * drawdown * (1.0 - 0.35 * overnight_phase)
    return df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_overnight_buffer"]
